---
title: "Figures"
format:
  emiljs:
    keep-emiljs: true
jupyter: python3
_quarto:
  tests:
    emiljs:
      noErrorsOrWarnings: []
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ['figure img[alt="Box plots of bill length."]', 'figure figcaption']
      ensureHtmlElementContents:
        - selectors: ['figure figcaption']
          # Quarto puts a non-breaking space between "Figure" and the number
          matches: ['Figure.1: Bill length by species\.']
      ensureEmiljsFileRegexMatches:
        - ['!\[Box plots of bill length\.\]\(.*fig-bills-output-1\.png\)\n\nFigure.1: Bill length by species\. \{\.caption\}', 'As Figure.1 shows']
        # no Quarto internals leak: no link anchors, fig-alt attribute or cell classes
        - ['fig-alt', 'quarto-xref', 'cell-code', '\]\(#fig-bills\)']
---

```{python}
#| label: fig-bills
#| fig-cap: "Bill length by species."
#| fig-alt: "Box plots of bill length."
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.plot([1, 2, 3])
plt.show()
```

As @fig-bills shows, Gentoo bills are shorter.
